DESCRIPTION: All product decisions behind this epic are resolved (2026-09-17) - see specs/tickets.md 'Decisions' table. Nothing here is blocked. Implements the budget-deficit setting, Reports/cycle alignment, 13th Month routing and the card-payment kind.

USER_STORY: As a user, I want to choose whether an overspent budget carries its deficit or resets clean, so the app behaves the way I expect after I overspend.
DESCRIPTION: Schema + Settings -> Budgets [7a, 28a] spec D1. 'carry' | 'reset'. Default 'reset' for new users, 'carry' on upgrade for existing users so nobody's figures change under them. Global, not per-budget - do not build both.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Two radios (not a toggle), each showing the figure it produces; copy is 'When you overspend' -> Reduce next cycle's budget / Start the next cycle fresh; the word 'rollover' is not used for the deficit; the existing per-budget surplus toggle is untouched and independent. Decided: under 'carry' the carried deficit clamps at zero - a budget never opens negative - and the uncarried remainder is reported in Overspending (LED-23), not discarded. Existing users keep 'carry' on upgrade; new users get 'reset'.

SUMMARY: Reports follows the global cycle; presets removed
USER_STORY: As a user, I want Reports to use the same month-cycle stepper as every other screen instead of its own seven date presets.
DESCRIPTION: ReportsPage.tsx, useReportPresets (deleted), useMonthCycle [9a, 28a] spec D3, Section2.3. Clean break - removed in the same release as the shell, no deprecation period.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: The seven presets and useReportPresets are gone; Reports reads useMonthCycle and shows the row-2 stepper like every other screen; stat cards, transaction table and category breakdown follow the selected cycle; trend charts get their own lookback, labelled on the chart and never driving the rest of the page (LED-21a sets its options).

USER_STORY: As a user viewing a Reports trend chart, I want to pick its lookback window independently of the page's month cycle.
DESCRIPTION: ReportsPage.tsx [30a], amending [9a, 28a]. The lookback D3 requires anyway becomes a small selector rather than a hardcoded 12 months, which is what keeps the three presets worth having.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Options are Last 30 days / Last 90 days / Year to date / Last 12 months, defaulting to 12 months; the selection sits on the chart card - never the header; the chart subtitle names both its range and its bucket size; bucket size adapts (30 days daily, 90 days weekly, YTD and 12 months monthly); the selection never affects the stat cards, transaction table or category breakdown, which stay on the stepper's cycle. Scope boundary: do not persist the lookback beyond the session, do not surface it in the header, and do not let the stat cards read it.

SUMMARY: 13th Month becomes a route, not a tab
USER_STORY: As a user, I want 13th Month reached by its own link, not nested inside Reports' date controls, since it has its own year selector and period semantics.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: ThirteenthMonthPage is out of TabsContent; Reports' tab row is two tabs (Overview, Analytics) and links to the route; /thirteenth-month is unchanged for anyone with the URL.

USER_STORY: As a user, I want to see which categories went over budget and by how much, even under the 'reset' deficit setting where nothing else records it.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Per cycle, per category, amount over budget, and a count of consecutive cycles over; populated regardless of the setting - under 'carry' it explains why the next cycle is lower, under 'reset' it is the only record; under 'carry' with a clamped deficit, the uncarried remainder is shown as its own figure; derived from existing data (budget amount vs category spend per cycle), no new write path.

USER_STORY: As a user paying off a credit card, I want a dedicated card-payment kind end to end, not a mis-inferred loan repayment.
DESCRIPTION: New 'card-payment' kind [12a] add-transaction-spec Section1.3, spec D4.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: The kind exists end to end per the add-transaction spec; 12a is built at all three sizes; a card payment saved before LED-08 re-infers correctly.
